description: A quick answer to a general-knowledge question, the first Tier 1 package - it runs in its own sandboxed process, not a shared recipe interpreter.
author: MaiPai

examples: tell me about the Eiffel Tower

data_sources.destination: Wikipedia's own public REST summary API (en.wikipedia.org)
data_sources.when: each time the family asks a general-knowledge question with no local offline copy to answer from
data_sources.what: the topic spoken in the request (e.g. 'Marie Curie')

fallback_reply.text: Sorry, I'm having trouble looking that up right now.
fallback_reply.speech: Sorry, I'm having trouble looking that up right now.
